name: bundle-advanced-ts
title: Large plain-JS bundle (with TypeScript), ADVANCED
description: The four plain scripts of `bundle` (12.6 MB: three.js r159 `build/three.js`, lodash 4.17.21 `lodash.js`, react-dom 18.3.1 `umd/react-dom.development.js` and TypeScript 5.6.3 `lib/typescript.js`) compiled in `ADVANCED` mode with `--jscomp_warning=checkVars` (demoting the 31 undeclared Node/UMD/WebXR globals from error to warning) and source map output.
